sourceAnchors.message: Ensure that resources like this ResultSet object are closed after use
sourceAnchors.reason: The verified alias returned by required(rows) is a null-checked reference to rows. It is the same object closed on all paths by the owning rows finally and cannot represent an extra acquisition.

sourceAnchors.reason: SS342/343 and SSC095 require closing acquired resources on SQL, Runtime and Error with their separate documented precedence. The catch preserves or propagates the corresponding identity and never discards unexpected failure.

sourceAnchors.message: To be compliant to J2EE, a webapp should not use any thread.
sourceAnchors.reason: This exact site uses an owned synthetic JUnit worker and a scheduled fixture. It does not create, observe or communicate with an application or database worker.
